entries.zh: 看管照应，注视其人所为（首字形存疑）
entries.en: to look after someone, watching what he does; to keep an eye on his conduct
entries.notes: 汉字「糕/糙」均不成词，据西语 cuidar mirando lo que hace 与 M/R 音写推断释义

entries.zh: 上进求胜，力求在名誉声望上胜过他人
entries.en: to strive to outdo others in honor and repute; to seek advancement
entries.notes: 「掌進」疑为「長進」之形讹，西语句尾以 ~ 略示未尽，取争先进取义

entries.zh: 〔语义存疑〕周全照管（「主細」非通见词）
entries.en: uncertain: presumably 'to take careful/continual charge' (unattested compound)
entries.notes: 西语 contento/corriento 转录存疑，汉字「主細」与音写不成通见词，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 关心挂念〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to be concerned about; to care about (entry struck through, Spanish text obliterated)
entries.notes: 整条圈划涂销、西语仅存 cuidar con…，据可辨汉字「關心」释义

entries.zh: 勤勉节俭，克勤克俭
entries.en: diligent and frugal; industrious and thrifty
entries.notes: 西语转录疑乱（desador medida mente，疑为 desmedidamente），据汉字「勤儉」与音写释义

entries.zh: 谨慎用心，留心在意
entries.en: to be careful and attentive

entries.zh: 留意切要，谨慎在意
entries.en: to pay heed to what is essential; to attend carefully
entries.notes: 「謹要」非常见词，西语与上条同文，据字面与音写推断

entries.zh: 勤勉用心，殷勤照管
entries.en: attentive care; diligent attendance

entries.zh: 勤勉谨慎
entries.en: diligent and careful; industrious and prudent

entries.zh: 勤勉，努力不懈
entries.en: diligent; industrious

entries.zh: 用心急切、事属紧要（组词字形存疑）
entries.en: to attend with urgency and diligence; urgent and essential business (compounds uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字两词与四音节不合，R 栏首词左端裁切且 M/R 语序互倒，据西语 cuidar con diligencia 推断

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕细心周到、留意其所为（疑为「細膩」之讹）
entries.en: meticulous in what one does; uncertain (damaged text)
entries.notes: R 栏残缺，「細二」不成词，疑为「細膩」之形讹，西语句读亦乱

entries.zh: 方法，做法
entries.en: method; way or manner of doing

entries.zh: 防守，戒备提防
entries.en: to guard, keep watch; to be on the alert
entries.notes: 首字「方/防」存疑，取「防守」，与西语 estar alerta 及音写相合

entries.zh: 张持，小心留意、戒慎提防
entries.en: to be careful and attentive; on one's guard

entries.zh: 用心任事、勤谨有加（组词字形存疑）
entries.en: to take care and apply oneself with diligence (characters uncertain)
entries.notes: 「發業」[疑:發/撥] 非常常见词，M/R 音写亦存疑，据西语 tener cuidado 释义

entries.zh: 约束，各守其分、尽其职守
entries.en: to keep one's obligation; to bind and restrain oneself

entries.zh: 立心，一心一意尽心照管
entries.en: to set one's heart on; to resolve with all one's heart

entries.zh: 统率，统领众务（如君王总揽）
entries.en: to command, lead in chief
entries.notes: 西语疑为 como Rey（如王）之误读，汉字「統率」清晰，两相吻合

entries.zh: 〔原件存疑〕司掌其业、经管所备之事（M/R 音写互歧）
entries.en: to superintend what is prepared; uncertain (M and R readings disagree)
entries.notes: M 读「司業」类音、R 读正业类音互歧，与西语 cuidar de lo que se apresta 之对应无法定夺

entries.zh: 谨身，谨慎持身
entries.en: to be circumspect in one's conduct; careful of oneself

entries.zh: 切要，紧要
entries.en: essential, indispensable; of pressing importance

entries.zh: 芫荽子实（culantro），首字难辨、字形存疑
entries.en: coriander/culantro (seed of a pungent herb); first character uncertain
entries.notes: 首字疑（皝/嵬）难辨且 M/R 第二音节互歧，仅西语 Culantro（芫荽类香料）之义较明
